rawModelHeadings.text: MINUTES OF THE INTERNATIONAL COMPARISON PROGRAM
TECHNICAL ADVISORY GROUP
Session I: Welcome and meeting objectives
Session II: Update on the ICP 2021 Cycle
1.Global office update
2.Regional updates
Africa
Asia and the Pacific
Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS)
Eurostat–OECD PPP Program
Latin America and the Caribbean
Western Asia
Session III: Short- and Long-Term Research and Development Agenda
1.Research Topics Emerging from the Previous ICP Cycles
2.Forthcoming Research Topics
Session IV: TAG Functioning and Terms of Reference for Task Forces
1.TAG Composition and Terms of Reference
2.Terms of Reference for a Task Force on Annual PPP Production
3.Terms of Reference for a Task Force on ICP Classification Update
Session V: Current Research
1.The Treatment of Import and Export Prices in International Comparisons
2.A Survey Based Approach to Adjustment for Quality Differences in Services in International Price Comparisons
3.Treatment of Scanner (Transaction) Data in the European Comparison Programme (ECP)
4.Treatment of Negative Expenditures in ICP
5.Fine Tuning Global Linking Procedures
6.Improving Reliability of Price Comparisons
Session VI: Any Other Business
Agenda DAY 1: Friday, March 7, 2025 | Chair: Paul SCHREYER SESSION I: Welcome and Opening Remarks
Update on the ICP 2021 and 2024 Cycles [World Bank and ICP Regional Implementing Agencies]
SESSION III: Short- and Long-Term Research and Development Agenda
Research Topics Emerging from the Previous ICP Cycles [World Bank] Forthcoming Research Topics [Prasada Rao]
Setting Up a Short- and Long-Term Research and Development Agenda [Co- Chairs and TAG]
SESSION IV: TAG Functioning and Terms of Refence for Task Forces 14:00 – 14:15 TAG Composition and Terms of Reference [TAG Co-Chairs]
14:15 – 15:00 Terms of Reference for a Task Force on Annual PPP Production [World Bank]
15:00 – 15:45 Terms of Reference for a Task Force on ICP Classification Update [World Bank]
SESSION V: Current Research
The Treatment of Import and Export Prices in International Comparisons [Rob Feenstra]
DAY 2: Saturday, March 8, 2025 | Chair: Prasada RAO
SESSION V: Current Research (Cont’d)
A Survey Based Approach to Adjustment for Quality Differences in Services in International Price Comparisons [Naohito Abe and Prasada Rao]
Treatment of Scanner (Transaction) Data in the European Comparison Program (ECP) [Eurostat]
Treatment of Negative Expenditures in ICP [Prasada Rao and Sergey Sergeev]
Fine Tuning Global Linking Procedures
Alternative Global Linking Methods [Robert Hill] Similarity Linking Within and Between Regions [Erwin Diewert and Yuri
Dikhanov] Improving Reliability of Price Comparisons – Basic Heading PPPs and Sparsity of Price Tableaus [Erwin Diewert]
Alternative Basic Heading PPP Aggregation Methods [Yuri Dikhanov]
SESSION VI: Closing
15:00 – 15:15 Any Other Business and Closing [TAG Co-Chairs]
Annex 2: List of Participants
ICP Technical Advisory Group members
ICP experts, guest speakers, and observers
ICP Inter-Agency Coordination Group (IACG)
World Bank
